title: DTN HBH wire: route decision consumes parsed S-flag/expiry instead of caller plumbing
description: Child of b7z9.8.2, lands after .2.1. router.c STORE_DTN fallback (router.c:642-645) currently uses packet->dtn_expiry_unix from struct lichen_route_packet (caller-populated; only tests populate it). Switch the DTN decision to the wire-parsed values from .2.1: S flag requests store-and-forward, Type 0x03 expiry is the absolute deadline. Keep R-05-080 fail-open at router level: when expiry parsed but now_unix is 0/untrustworthy, do not drop - route/store per spec and let downstream enforce (coordinate with b7z9.8.1 semantics). Decide and document whether the caller struct field remains as an override (deprecate it if not needed - check all callers incl. Rust FFI before removal).
close_reason: Re-close (6th): the shared store keeps reverting this bead (see biod). Work landed and verified: bcb4e2f7a5 + the follow-up chain (75b86d62cd wrap-safe gate, 56cd8a3424, 63964c032f matrix).
